verdict.rationale: Brevo documents an SMTP templates API endpoint that can filter templates by status and editor type, so templates are API-managed. It also documents personalizing email content per recipient with dynamic variables. The evidence does not show creating or updating templates from HTML/MJML source, and nothing shows templates kept under version control. Missing for 10: documented template create/update via API with raw HTML/MJML, explicit template variable syntax tied to stored templates, version-control or templates-as-code workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control

citations.quote: You can filter by active/inactive status using `templateStatus` and by editor type using `editorType` (currently only `richTextEditor` is supported).
Personalize content for each recipient using dynamic variables.
